headline: Earnings fall on tough comp; outlook raised on CA sale
summary_short: Camden Property Trust reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $0.18, down from $0.74 a year ago and $0.40 last quarter, as the year-ago quarter included a $47.3M gain on a property sale; FFO per share was flat at $1.68.
summary_long: EPS of $0.18 fell 75.7% y/y and 55.0% q/q, mostly explained by the absence of a $47.3M gain on sale of operating property booked in Q2 2025 (none in Q2 2026), plus higher interest expense (+$6.0M) and depreciation (+$5.0M). FFO per diluted share held flat at $1.68 y/y; Core AFFO fell to $1.39 from $1.43. Same-property NOI (excluding California) fell 1.4% y/y as expense growth (+2.4%) outpaced revenue (-0.1%); occupancy held at 95.7%. Camden sold its 11-community California portfolio for $1.625B on July 29, 2026. 2026 EPS guidance raised to $9.76-$10.10 (from $9.27 midpoint) on the anticipated sale gain; Core FFO guidance held at $6.68-$6.82. Cash was $44.7M; long-term debt rose to $4.85B from $4.25B q/q.
